description: Redesign AnalyticsPage (Historical Analytics) with sentence-case Bricolage Grotesque headings, a single unified control bar (Chart/Table view switch LEFT, time-range group RIGHT, NO duplicate time toggle inside charts), summary strip showing total/peak/average energy, chart cards with landing page tokens and 28px radius, table with sticky header and tabular-nums, Export CSV button, friendly error state, skeleton loading. Remove PublicUserBanner. Remove the duplicate second time toggle inside chart cards.
steps: Open frontend/src/features/analytics/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx, delete the <PublicUserBanner /> line and its import statement
Update page background to backgroundColor: 'var(--landing-bg)'
Change page title to 'Historical analytics' (sentence case, NOT 'Analytics'), fontFamily: 'Bricolage Grotesque', fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 'clamp(30px, 4vw, 44px)', letterSpacing: '-0.03em'
Change subtitle to sentence case, fontSize: 15px, fontWeight: 400, color: 'var(--landing-mute)'
If isPublicUser, render 'Read-only' chip next to title (same as FEAT-003)

Redesign control bar: create one row with two segmented pill groups. LEFT group: Chart View (chart-column icon) / Historical View (table-2 icon) with sliding highlight (reuse useSlidingIndicator or create inline animated indicator), active view gets background: 'var(--landing-soft)'. RIGHT group: Today / 7d / 30d / 3mo buttons with sliding highlight, active range gets background: 'var(--landing-soft)'. Use borderRadius: '999px' for pill container, gap: '2px' between buttons, cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.15, 1) transition.
Remove the duplicate time toggle that currently exists inside PowerGenerationChart or any chart card (search for a second set of time-range buttons inside chart components, delete them)
State management: use useSearchParams to persist view and range in URL query params: ?range=7d&view=chart. Read params on mount, update on button click.

Add summary strip below control bar: 3 summary tiles in a row (inline-flex, gap: 16px). Each tile shows: large number (28px, weight 800, tabular-nums) + unit, label (13px, weight 600, uppercase, var(--landing-mute)). Tiles: 'Total energy generated' (sum from API), 'Peak power' (max from API), 'Average power' (mean from API). Show '--' while isLoading, show calculated values once data arrives. Tile style: background: 'var(--landing-surface)', border: '1px solid var(--landing-line)', borderRadius: '20px', padding: '16px 20px'.

Update all chart components (PowerGenerationChart, EnergyPeriodChart, CumulativeEnergyChart, StepsChart, VoltageCurrentChart) styling: background: 'var(--landing-surface)', border: '1px solid var(--landing-line)', borderRadius: '28px', padding: '24px'
In all chart components, change chart title font to Bricolage Grotesque weight 600, 18px
In all chart components, change axis labels to Bricolage Grotesque 13px

In all chart components, set Recharts grid stroke to 'var(--landing-line)', chart line/bar colors to voltage='var(--landing-blue)', current='var(--landing-amber)', power/energy='var(--landing-green)', danger='var(--landing-danger)'
In all chart components error state, replace raw 'Network Error' with friendly message: 'Unable to load chart data', circle-alert icon, Retry button (pill shape, var(--landing-green) background)

Open frontend/src/features/analytics/components/HistoricalDataView.tsx, update table styling: thead sticky (position: sticky, top: 0, zIndex: 10), background: 'var(--landing-surface)', borderBottom: '2px solid var(--landing-line)', th fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 14px
In HistoricalDataView table rows: borderBottom: '1px solid var(--landing-line)', hover background: 'var(--landing-soft)'
In HistoricalDataView numeric columns: fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', textAlign: 'right'
In HistoricalDataView pagination: pill buttons, active button background: 'var(--landing-green)', inactive border: '1px solid var(--landing-line)'

If analytics hooks provide data export capability (check useAnalyticsData or similar for exportCSV method), add Export CSV button in control bar or summary area: <button style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', padding: '10px 18px', borderRadius: '999px', background: 'var(--landing-surface)', border: '1px solid var(--landing-line)' }} onClick={handleExportCSV}><Download size={16} />Export CSV</button>

Add skeleton loading: while isLoading, render gray skeleton cards with opacity pulse animation (keyframes: @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; } 50% { opacity: 0.7; } }, animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite) where charts/table would be

Update responsive styles: desktop 2-column chart grid where specified, tablet single-column, mobile single-column everything, segmented controls scroll horizontally with overflow-x: auto, 44px min touch targets on mobile

Add accessibility: visible focus ring (3px solid var(--landing-green)), aria-labels on icon buttons, aria-label on chart SVGs with summary text (e.g., 'Power generation chart showing 7 days of data'), prefers-reduced-motion guard
acceptance_criteria: PublicUserBanner does not render on AnalyticsPage
Page title is 'Historical analytics' (sentence case, Bricolage Grotesque)
Public users see a single 'Read-only' chip
One unified control bar with Chart/Table switch (left) and time-range group (right), NO duplicate time toggle inside any chart
Summary strip shows total energy, peak power, average power (or '--' while loading)
All chart cards use var(--landing-surface) background, 1px solid var(--landing-line) border, 28px radius
Chart titles and axis labels use Bricolage Grotesque
Table has sticky header, tabular-nums for numeric columns, hover effect (var(--landing-soft) background)
Export CSV button is present (if data export is available in hooks)
Friendly error state (no raw 'Network Error' or 'Technical Details')
Skeleton loading appears on initial page load
Responsive layouts work: 2-column charts on desktop, single-column on tablet/mobile, segmented controls scroll horizontally on mobile
Focus ring is visible on all interactive elements
URL query params persist view and range: ?range=30d&view=chart
verification: Run 'npm run build' — build succeeds with no errors
Start dev server, navigate to http://localhost:5173/analytics as public — page renders with new design, unified control bar at top, summary strip below
Click 'Historical View' button — URL updates to ?view=historical, table appears
Click '30d' button — URL updates to ?range=30d, data refetches for 30-day range
Scroll down to charts (if in Chart View) — no duplicate time-range buttons inside any chart card
Check summary strip — if data is loaded, shows numeric values (e.g., 'Total energy generated: 45.2 kWh'), if loading shows '--'
Resize browser to mobile width (<560px) — control bar segmented pills scroll horizontally, charts stack vertically
Tab through interactive elements — focus ring is visible
Check DevTools Elements inspector: chart cards have background: var(--landing-surface), border: 1px solid var(--landing-line), borderRadius: 28px
If Export CSV button is present, click it — CSV file downloads (or error message if not implemented yet)
